name: gui
caption:
PICK 55 🎮🏀 The 55th pick, from Brazil. Now he's starting games for us.

• 2022 draft: we take Gui Santos at #55
• Rookie year: 23 games, 3.6 PPG, in and out of Santa Cruz
• 2026: 3-year extension, then a career-high 31 vs Brooklyn
• First 7 games this season: 5 starts

Starter or bench guy? 👇
